claims.text: Stable, coherent nanoscale precipitates in tungsten-based refractory HEAs act as dislocation-pinning sites.
Dislocation pinning by the precipitates mitigates grain-boundary sliding.
The precipitates mitigate irradiation-induced defect accumulation.
Precipitate-mediated suppression of dislocation motion, grain-boundary sliding, and defect accumulation governs sustained high-temperature plastic strain capacity.
The same precipitate-mediated mechanism governs fracture toughness under high-temperature irradiation.
A directed nanoprecipitate distribution obstructs dislocation motion in the matrix.
A directed nanoprecipitate distribution stabilizes the alloy microstructure at elevated temperatures.
Precipitates reduce damage accumulation and crack-initiation sites under thermal and irradiation stress.
The precipitate-containing alloy will have greater plastic strain capacity than the precipitate-free baseline under identical high-temperature irradiation.
The precipitate-containing alloy will have greater fracture toughness than the precipitate-free baseline under identical high-temperature irradiation.
The proposed improvement should hold above approximately 600 °C at representative neutron or ion doses, provided that the precipitates remain stable.
Extreme irradiation fluences or extended exposure may degrade the precipitate structure and diminish its mechanical effect.
The magnitude of toughness and plasticity gains depends on precipitate stability and morphology.
Precipitates may change morphology or dissolve at high temperatures and irradiation doses.
The controlled comparison uses a precipitate-containing variant and a precipitate-free tungsten-based refractory HEA tested under identical conditions.
Failure of the precipitate-containing alloy to increase either ductility or toughness relative to the control is designated as falsifying the hypothesis.

contradictions.description: The intervention allows precipitates to be introduced through tailored composition while calling the resulting material otherwise identical, whereas the baseline is specified as having the same bulk composition. A compositionally tailored variant would not satisfy that same-composition control.
